$comment: Temporal Registry and Spatial Registry seeds (Phase 003 §19–20). Calendars and reference frames are registered; recurrence schemes and regions are registered by domain authorities at runtime. Intervals are half-open [start, end) by declared convention (V-TM-02).

calendars.name: gregorian
calendars.statement: The proleptic Gregorian calendar with instants in ISO-8601 UTC and half-open intervals.

calendars.name: iso-week
calendars.statement: The ISO-8601 week-numbering calendar over the Gregorian day count.

recurrenceSchemes.name: bounded-periodic
recurrenceSchemes.statement: A recurrence with a frequency, interval, optional weekday filter and mandatory count or until bound.

frames.name: WGS84
frames.statement: The World Geodetic System 1984 ellipsoidal reference frame, positions as latitude and longitude in degrees.
